verdict_reason: The PR's own change (package rename to addressbook) is correct and consistent with logback-spring.xml, but the class it moves is dead code whose stated purpose is not how service.version actually reaches the ECS encoder.

todos.issue: The whole class is a no-op: setupServiceVersion() writes a JVM system property 'service.version' that nothing ever reads — logback-spring.xml resolves service.version via <springProperty name="service.version" source="cdp.service-version"/>, and a springProperty always shadows a same-named system property; worse, @PostConstruct fires long after Logback has initialised, so a system property set here could never influence the encoder even if the XML did read it.
todos.fix: Delete LoggingConfig (EcsLoggingIT's service.version assertion is satisfied by the springProperty/<serviceVersion> wiring alone); if a real system property is ever needed for logging, set it from an EnvironmentPostProcessor that runs before LoggingApplicationListener.

todos.issue: MDC key naming is inconsistent with RequestTracingFilter: there the MDC_* constants (MDC_TRACE_ID, MDC_HTTP_METHOD, MDC_URL_FULL) really are MDC.put keys, whereas MDC_SERVICE_VERSION here is used as a System.setProperty key and the class Javadoc claims it 'Sets up service version in MDC' — nothing in this class touches MDC.
todos.fix: If the class survives, rename the constant to SERVICE_VERSION_PROPERTY and correct the Javadoc; otherwise remove it with the class.

todos.issue: org.springframework.boot.info.BuildProperties and java.util.Optional are imported but never used; the pom has no spotless/checkstyle/PMD plugin, so nothing in the build will catch them.
todos.fix: Remove both imports (or the whole class per item 1).

todos.issue: @Value field injection on serviceVersion contradicts the bundle's constructor-injection rule ('@Autowired field injection -> Constructor injection'), and leaves the field non-final and untestable without reflection.
todos.fix: If retained, take the value as a constructor parameter (@Value on the ctor arg) and make the field final.
